method: Edge-chained word table fitted on the Hand 2 pages of the public practice training split only, with no grammar or meaning. Two tallies are counted from those pages: how often each first glyph follows each last glyph between adjacent certain words within a line (eva-basic glyphs), and the certain words beginning with each glyph with their frequencies. Text is written word by word: draw the next word's first glyph given the previous word's last glyph, then a word starting with that glyph by frequency; a draw that would complete a four-word run found in the manuscript is redrawn (seed 2027, 40,000 words in lines of ten; the scorer re-cuts them to the hidden line shapes). The writer carries one glyph of memory and never sees line or page breaks. On the practice split the fact holds on this text (0.341 against 0.325 for the manuscript), including both shuffle nulls.
